calculate_round_trip_l2_distance: calculate the L2 distance between prediction text and target embeddings using the round_trip_l2_distance function
calculate_round_trip_cosine_similarity: calculate cosine similarity between prediction text and target embeddings using the round_trip_cos function
run_round_trip_l2_with_flatten: run round_trip_l2_distance with flatten=True to get a flat list of L2 distance values
run_round_trip_cos_evaluation: run round_trip_cos to evaluate how closely generated text matches target embeddings in sonar space
compare_round_trip_metrics: compare round_trip_l2_distance and round_trip_cos results to assess text-to-embedding reconstruction quality
